_help: Tunable preferences injected into every prompt as additionalContext. Edit and the next prompt picks it up (no restart). Set any value to null or empty string to disable that line.
_conciseness_help: 1 (verbose, full explanations) → 10 (terse, one-liner answers only). Default 8.
_complexity_help: 1 (ELI5, define every term) → 10 (assume expert, no preamble). Default 9.
_subagent_help: Add a reminder on every prompt to delegate exploration to subagents (per CLAUDE.md). Default true.
_custom_help: Free-form text appended to every additionalContext. Use for project-specific reminders ('always cite file:line', 'use tabs not spaces', etc.).
